What car repair services do you offer in Dubai?

We cover everything from routine oil changes and tyre fitting to engine diagnostics, car AC repair, battery replacement, full car inspection, and emergency roadside assistance. We also send mobile mechanics anywhere in Dubai.

Do you offer mobile car repair in Dubai?

Yes. Our mobile mechanics come to your home, office, or roadside location for oil changes, battery swaps, tyre fitting, and minor repairs — no need to visit the workshop.

Prices range from around AED 50 for a fluid top-up to AED 2,500+ for major engine work. You always get a written estimate before we start — no surprises, no hidden charges.

Yes. We are open Saturday through Friday, 7 AM to 10 PM, including all public holidays.

Our garage is at 222 Al Satwa Road, Al Satwa — a few minutes from Sheikh Zayed Road, Jumeirah, DIFC, and Downtown Dubai.
